description: This script manages CPU affinity and load balancing for network interface queues, implementing packet steering configurations based on CPU and IRQ processing. It utilizes system files such as /proc/interrupts and /sys/class/net, and interacts with UCI configuration system for conditional execution.

methods.name: find_irq_cpu
methods.description: Determines the CPU affinity index for a given device based on /proc/interrupts

methods.name: set_hex_val
methods.description: Sets a hexadecimal value in a specified system file, optionally printing debug info
